title: Similar Is Not Useful: Selecting In-Context Demonstrations by Closed-Loop Utility
abstract: arXiv:2611.22295v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) policies fill their context with the demonstrations whose frames look most like the current observation under frozen DINOv2 embeddings. We ask whether visual similarity selects the demonstrations that make the policy succeed. For a frozen retrieval-augmented VLA (RICL on $\pi_0$-FAST, LIBERO), we make the demonstration pool swappable at run time and score each demonstration's utility by regressing the closed-loop success of 60 fixed-size pools on their membership. On initial states disjoint from those used for scoring, pools of the five highest-utility demonstrations succeed on 66.4% of 760 paired episodes across 19 tasks, pools of the five most similar on 55.7%, and random pools on 55.5%. translated_title: 相似并不等于有用：基于闭环效用的上下文示范选择
translated_abstract: 检索增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常利用冻结的DINOv2嵌入，将与当前观测画面最相似的演示填充到上下文中。我们探究这种视觉相似性是否真能选出使策略成功的演示。针对一个冻结的检索增强VLA（RICL on π₀-FAST，LIBERO），我们使演示池可以在运行时动态替换，并通过将60个固定大小演示池的闭环任务成功率对其成员关系进行回归，为每个演示打分其“效用”。在与评分所用初始状态不相交的新初始状态上，包含五个最高效用演示的池在19个任务的760个配对片段中成功率为66.4%，五个最相似演示的池为55.7%，随机池为55.5%。效用选择比相似性选择高出10.8个百分点（p=3.2×10⁻⁶；在18个未打平任务中有15个为正向提升），其中包括12个策略从未被演示引导过的任务，而相似性选择的演示池表现并不优于随机……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出用“闭环效用”（即演示对任务实际成功率的贡献）而非视觉相似性来为检索增强VLA策略选择上下文演示，实验证明效用选择的演示池成功率比相似性选择高出10.8个百分点，且在策略从未见过的任务上同样有效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes selecting in-context demonstrations for retrieval-augmented VLA policies by closed-loop utility (their measured contribution to task success) rather than visual similarity, showing utility-selected pools outperform similarity-selected ones by 10.8 percentage points, including on tasks never seen by the policy.
